notes.title: Blades, Bows & Magic Steam Page is Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to Blades, Bows & Magic![/h2]

A casual, medieval fantasy, strategy card battler. Duel champions across the land in singleplayer and unlock new cards with special abilities. Challenge other players or your friends in online PvP multiplayer with our distinctive tactical battle system.

Wishlist today on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3182730/Blades_Bows_and_Magic/

Play the Alpha Demo on Itch: [url=https://funkgames.itch.io/blades-bows-and-magic]https://funkgames.itch.io/blades-bows-and-magic[/url]

Join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/xNXXdpcNEE]https://discord.gg/xNXXdpcNEE[/url]

Thank you ;)
